scope: global brighter dark-premium visual system across TODAY, WORKOUT, NUTRITION, PROGRESS, AI COACH
programme meal actions synchronized to journal
AJUSTER flow with per-food actual quantities
weekly menu selection tied to current BODY OS workout family

nutrition_logging.consumed: upserts full planned meal into daily journal
nutrition_logging.adjust: opens per-food quantity editor then upserts adjusted meal
nutrition_logging.macro_recalculation: estimated proportionally from entered quantity ratios because per-food nutrient data is not yet modeled

weekly_rotation.source: current BODY OS workout day from store.getDay() / sessions
weekly_rotation.pool_selection: advances with weekly seed; same week stable unless NOUVEAU MENU is used

limitations: Adjusted meal macro recalculation is proportional estimation, not ingredient-level nutrition database computation.
No backend AI/photo nutrition recognition in this version.
Real photographic food thumbnails remain a future media pass.
